summary: Dependency resolved from off-registry URL at artifacts.koliroute.com
details: package.json line 12 declares its sole dependency, "linker-client-string-async", as a bare URL (https://artifacts.koliroute.com/npm/linker-client-string-async) instead of a registry version range. Installing the package causes npm to fetch and install whatever tarball that host returns, executing any lifecycle scripts it contains, with no version pin, no registry provenance and no integrity check. The host is unrelated to any declared repository or homepage, and the content it serves can change at any time. The shipped code is a one-line re-export of that dependency, so the manifest entry is effectively the package's entire functional surface; the absence of lifecycle scripts in this tarball does not prevent the fetch or the execution of scripts inside the fetched artifact.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
